functions.name: get-events-token
functions.description: Get metadata for the connection's Events API token, including its reported identifier, issue instant, enabled event features, and account when available. Does not return the bearer token secret.

FunctionInput_1password_events_getevents.description: Inspect the connected Events API token without supplying credentials or an identifier.

id.description: Opaque uuid reported by token introspection; no account identity is inferred from this value.

features.description: Exact enabled event feature strings, such as auditevents, itemusages and signinattempts. Empty means the provider explicitly returned no features; omission means unavailable.

items.description: An exact provider-reported enabled event feature string.

issuedAt.description: Reported token issue instant normalized to UTC Z with fractional precision retained.

accountId.description: Opaque account_uuid returned by introspection, omitted when unavailable, including legacy responses.

FunctionOutput_1password_events_getevent.description: Safe metadata reported for the connected Events API token; never contains the bearer token secret.

tags.instructions: Use this to inspect the connected token's metadata or determine which event collections it enables. You do not need to supply a token or identifier. This does not create, renew, revoke, or reveal credentials. Use `list-audit-events`, `list-item-usage-events`, or `list-sign-in-attempts` to read the corresponding events; feature metadata alone does not retrieve records.

functions.name: list-audit-events
functions.description: List one page of account audit events describing actions performed by team members, optionally within a time range.

endAt.description: Provider time-range end as an RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset. Omission uses the provider's default range; boundary inclusivity is provider-defined.

limit.description: Requested maximum events on the initial page; defaults to 100. Continuation pages inherit the provider cursor's settings.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this tool on the same connection. Supply alone, without time bounds or limit.

startAt.description: Provider time-range start as an RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset. Omission uses the provider's default range; boundary inclusivity is provider-defined.

FunctionInput_1password_events_listaudit.description: An initial audit-event page request or an opaque continuation cursor supplied alone.

id.description: Opaque audit event identifier from uuid.

auxId.description: Provider auxiliary integer identifier rendered as an opaque decimal string, without interpreting its meaning.

action.description: Exact provider action code, such as create, update, or revoke.

auxInfo.description: Auxiliary information preserved as ordinary text, including an empty string if returned.

auxUuid.description: Additional opaque UUID reported by the event; relationship depends on action.

session.description: Session information reported with the audit event.

loginAt.description: Session login instant normalized to UTC with Z, preserving fractional precision.

deviceId.description: Opaque identifier of the session's device.

ipAddress.description: Reported session IP address, preserved as text.

location.description: Provider-reported client geolocation, omitted when unavailable.

latitude.description: Provider-reported latitude coordinate, without swapping axes.

longitude.description: Provider-reported longitude coordinate, without swapping axes.

objectId.description: Opaque identifier of the affected object.

accountId.description: Opaque account identifier reported for the event; omitted when unavailable.

actorType.description: Reported actor classification, such as user or external_user; not inferred.

name.description: Reported full name, without text normalization.

objectType.description: Exact provider object-type code identifying the kind of affected resource.

occurredAt.description: Event timestamp normalized to UTC with Z, preserving fractional precision.

actorDetails.description: Provider-reported actor details, omitted when unavailable.

name.description: Reported full name, without text normalization.

objectDetails.description: Provider-reported object details in its user-shaped representation.

name.description: Reported full name, without text normalization.

actorAccountId.description: Opaque identifier of the actor's account, when reported.

items.description: A normalized audit event preserving provider field availability.
Audit events in this provider page, preserving provider order; may be empty even with nextCursor.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for this collection and connection, present only when the provider indicates there may be more results.

FunctionOutput_1password_events_listaudi.description: One page of audit events and an optional browsing continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this for on-demand audit history, not current account or user settings. No event ID is needed. Optionally choose a time range and an initial page size of 1–1000. Pass `nextCursor` alone as `cursor` to continue with the same connection and event collection; even an empty page can have a continuation. Stop when `nextCursor` is absent. Use `get-events-token` to inspect which event features the connection can access.

functions.name: list-item-usage-events
functions.description: List one page of events recording usage of items stored in shared vaults, optionally within a time range. This returns usage metadata, not secret item contents.

endAt.description: Requested range end as an RFC 3339 instant with explicit offset. Omission uses the provider default; inclusivity is provider-defined.

limit.description: Maximum events requested for the initial page, default 100; continuation settings belong to the cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this tool on the same connection; supply alone without range or limit.

startAt.description: Requested range start as an RFC 3339 instant with explicit offset. Omission uses the provider default; inclusivity is provider-defined.

FunctionInput_1password_events_listitemu.description: Read one shared-vault item usage page using an initial range or a continuation cursor alone.

user.description: Reported user responsible for the usage.

name.description: Reported full name as ordinary Unicode text.

type.description: Exact reported user classification, such as user or external_user.

accountId.description: Opaque account identifier reported for this user.

action.description: Exact usage action code, such as reveal, fill or server-fetch.

client.description: Reported client application, platform and IP metadata.

ipAddress.description: Reported client IP address as text.

appVersion.description: Reported application version, preserved as text.

platformVersion.description: Reported platform version or model; may describe a browser, computer model, or CPU depending on client.

itemId.description: Opaque identifier of the used item; not its secret contents.

vaultId.description: Opaque identifier of the shared vault containing the item.

location.description: Reported client geolocation, omitted when unavailable.

country.description: Country value preserved exactly as reported.

latitude.description: Reported latitude coordinate, without inferred correction.

longitude.description: Reported longitude coordinate, without inferred correction.

accountId.description: Opaque event account identifier, omitted when unavailable.

occurredAt.description: Usage instant normalized to UTC Z, retaining fractional precision.

usedVersion.description: Provider-reported version of the item used in this event.

items.description: One shared-vault item usage event containing metadata, not item contents.
Usage events in this provider page, retaining order; may be empty with a continuation.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for this collection and connection, omitted when the provider reports no more current results.

FunctionOutput_1password_events_listitem.description: One ordered page of shared-vault item usage metadata and any current continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this to investigate shared-vault item activity, not to retrieve vault items or secret values. Optionally choose a time range and an initial limit of 1–1000. Continue by passing `nextCursor` alone as `cursor` on the same connection and collection; an empty page can still have a continuation. Stop when it is absent. Use `get-events-token` to check enabled event features.

functions.name: list-sign-in-attempts
functions.description: List one page of successful and failed attempts to sign into the connected account, optionally within a time range.

endAt.description: Requested range end as an RFC 3339 instant with explicit offset. Omission uses the provider default; inclusivity is provider-defined.

limit.description: Maximum attempts requested for the initial page, default 100. Continuation settings are carried by the cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this tool on the same connection; supply alone without time bounds or limit.

startAt.description: Requested range start as an RFC 3339 instant with explicit offset. Omission uses the provider default; inclusivity is provider-defined.

FunctionInput_1password_events_listsigni.description: Optional sign-in attempt time bounds and initial page size, or a continuation cursor alone.

id.description: Opaque sign-in attempt identifier from uuid.

type.description: Exact provider attempt-type code, such as continent_blocked; spelling is preserved.

client.description: Reported client application, platform and IP metadata.

ipAddress.description: Reported client IP address as text.

platformVersion.description: Reported browser version, machine model or CPU description depending on client.

country.description: Attempt-level country value exactly as reported, separate from location.country; no ISO-code enforcement because examples are inconsistent.

value.description: Additional provider text; for firewall-blocked attempts it identifies the blocking continent, country or other rule value.

category.description: Exact provider result category, such as success, credentials_failed or firewall_reported_success; not collapsed to a boolean.

location.description: Reported client geolocation, omitted when unavailable.

country.description: Country value exactly as reported within geolocation.

latitude.description: Reported latitude coordinate without inferred correction.

longitude.description: Reported longitude coordinate without inferred correction.

accountId.description: Opaque event account identifier, when reported.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier reported for the attempt.

occurredAt.description: Attempt instant normalized to UTC Z, retaining fractional precision.

targetUser.description: Reported user whose account the attempt targeted.

name.description: Reported full name, preserving Unicode text.

type.description: Reported user classification, such as user or external_user.

accountId.description: Opaque account identifier reported for the target user.

items.description: A sign-in attempt with exact provider classifications and normalized metadata.
Sign-in attempts in this provider page, retaining provider order; may be empty with a continuation.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for this collection and connection; absent when the provider reports no more current results.

FunctionOutput_1password_events_listsign.description: One provider page of sign-in attempts and an optional continuation for more current results.

tags.instructions: Use this for sign-in investigations, not to initiate sign-in or change security settings. Optionally choose a time range and an initial limit of 1–1000. Pass `nextCursor` alone as `cursor` on the same connection and collection to continue; an empty page can still have a continuation. Stop when it is absent. Use `get-events-token` to check enabled event features. Interpret category and type together rather than treating every non-success code as equivalent.
